10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
16: - Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
17: - Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable neon cyberpunk 2D roguelike-style civilization simulator.

## Requirements
- Real-time simulation with autonomous NPC lives, construction, economy, and social development.
- Dark pixel-art aesthetic with neon visuals and particles.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained browser game in a single HTML file with canvas-rendered pixel-style graphics and UI.
- Chose a colony-management survival loop: build the district, support residents, defend against raids, and grow Haven-09.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a playable game with autonomous residents, needs and moods, buildings, resources, real-time clock and speed controls, expeditions, raids, citizen profiles, and win/lose conditions.
- Verified JavaScript syntax and browser functionality; no page errors observed.
- Tested placing a building and opening the expedition modal.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Optionally review the latest screenshot or continue polishing gameplay and responsive behavior.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local preview was served at `http://localhost:3002`.
- Latest screenshot saved at `/tmp/opencode/afterlight.jpg`.

content.text:
Built the playable game in `index.html` as **Afterlight**, a real-time neon cyberpunk colony simulator.

Residents follow autonomous routines, manage their needs, work and socialize. You can build shelters, farms, reactors, markets, med bays, and sentinels; send expeditions; and manage resources, raids, and settlement growth. The game includes citizen profiles, simulation speed and pause controls, and win/lose conditions.

Assumption: the civilization-management loop is the core gameplay, with the player guiding the district while residents act on their own. Verified the JavaScript syntax and tested the browser view, building placement, and expedition modal; no page errors were observed.
